uncertain: Prison corridor proportions and cell assignments remain unverified. Q1–Q3 mark the prison search area; their relative ordering is not a claimed cell order.
The two detention loops and the arena approach are schematic; local bends and elevation changes are not measured.

notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
The unlabelled square in panel II represents Shadowforge Lock on the lower garrison level. Operate it before using F.

Arena encounter 4 has alternatives: Anub’shiah, Eviscerator, Gorosh the Dervish, Grizzle, Hedrum the Creeper or Ok’thor the Breaker. Theldren is a quest-triggered alternative at the same location. High Justice Grimstone is not a separate kill target.
B and D are locked shortcuts requiring the appropriate key or unlocking method.
No escort path or extra prison rooms are invented.
